study: round three of user-authorized MA+price/volume study
clue: isolate positive opening gap from MA alignment and joint widening, then compare paired conditions

candidate_formulas.gap_up_only: positive open / previous adjusted close - 1, without MA condition
candidate_formulas.widen_gap_up_control: round-two control: positive gap times joint widening
candidate_formulas.aligned_gap_up_no_widen: positive gap with aligned MAs but without positive joint widening
candidate_formulas.widen_gap_up_green: joint widening times positive gap times positive intraday body / ATR14
candidate_formulas.widen_gap_up_red: joint widening times positive gap times negative intraday body / ATR14
candidate_formulas.widen_gap_up_volume_up: joint widening times positive gap times positive(volume / mean20 - 1)
candidate_formulas.widen_gap_up_volume_down: joint widening times positive gap times positive(1 - volume / mean20)
candidate_formulas.widen_gap_up_breakout: joint widening times positive gap if close > previous 20-bar high
candidate_formulas.widen_gap_up_inside: joint widening times positive gap if close <= previous 20-bar high
candidate_formulas.widen_gap_up_small: joint widening times positive gap if open-previous close <= 0.5 ATR14
candidate_formulas.widen_gap_up_large: joint widening times positive gap if open-previous close > 0.5 ATR14

data_and_return_rules: identical to round one; historical CSI300 exploration only
primary: own five-day mean return and up rate; 0.3% cost sensitivity
auxiliary: same-day cohort edge and rank IC; not vetoes
historical_screen: three eras each >=20 signal dates, >=200 positions, own mean >0.3%
